dashboard.title: Tableau ya mosala
dashboard.description: Bókamba catalogue na bino, bólanda mbongo, bótala mafuta, mpe bóbakisa bato oyo bayokaka bino — nyonso na esika moko.

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.noAssetsDescription: Tia nzembo ya liboso mpo na kobanda.

revenue.title: Mbongo
revenue.noArtistRevenue: Mbongo ya artiste ezali naino te. Mbongo ekobima awa ntango bato bakobanda koyoka miziki na bino.
revenue.noRevenueEvents: Makambo ya mbongo ezali naino te. Ekobima awa ntango catalogue na bino ekobanda kobimisa mbongo.

payouts.title: Mafuta
payouts.description: Mbongo ya ba-artistes na boyebi ya mafuta
payouts.noPayoutsDescription: Mafuta ya ba-artistes ekobima awa nsima ya kokabola mbongo.
payouts.noPendingBalance: Mbongo moko te ezali kozela mpo na artiste oyo.
payouts.payoutFailed: Mafuta ekokaki te kosalema. Vérifiá configuration ya nzela ya kofuta ya artiste mpe meká lisusu, to benga support.

splits.title: Bokaboli ya mbongo
splits.description: Bongisá ndenge mbongo ekokabolama na kati ya basali-elongo. Bokaboli esengeli kozala exactement 100%. Mosali-elongo mokomoko akozwa ndambo na ye nsima ya kolongola frais.
splits.underAllocated: Ezali na nse na {amount}%. Nyonso esengeli kozala 100%.

hero.badge: Miziki ya Afrika, scène ya mokili
hero.title: Miziki na
hero.description: Yoká malamu ya miziki ya Afrika — Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife, mpe ba-genres 40+. Ba-artistes bazwi 85% ya écoute nyonso. Ba-labels bakoli na continent mobimba.

stakeholders.badge: Mpo na bato nyonso ya miziki
stakeholders.title: Plateforme moko,
stakeholders.description: Soki ozali kosala miziki, koyoka, kokamba to kobongisa — Zonga esalami mpo na yo.

listeners.title: Mpo na bayoki
listeners.description: Kumisa malamu ya miziki ya Afrika — Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife, Bongo, mpe mingi koleka. Landa ba-artistes, salá ba-playlists, mpe yoká ofele.

artists.title: Mpo na ba-artistes
artists.description: Kabola miziki na yo, zwá 85% ya mbongo, mpe batelá masters na yo — na mafuta ya mbala moko na mobile money, banque to crypto.
highlights: Mafuta ya mbala moko mobile money

labels.title: Mpo na ba-labels
labels.description: Bongisa ba-artistes na yo, automatiser ba-splits ya royalties, mpe kokola distribution na continent mobimba — na conformité mobimba.

events.title: Mpo na ba-organisateurs
events.description: Tékisa ba-billets, bongisa ba-événements, mpe kangana na ba-fans — na plateforme ndenge moko oyo ba-artistes batii motema.

features.title: Yoká, salá,
features.description: Fonctionnalités mpo na bayoki oyo balingi miziki ya kitoko mpe ba-créateurs oyo baméritaka mafuta ya bosembo — nyonso na plateforme moko.

items.title: Yoká mpe kumisa
items.description: Luká ba-titres ebele na ba-genres 40+ ya Afrika — banda Afrobeats na Amapiano tii na Highlife na Soukous. Ofele, tango nyonso.

items.title: Ba-playlists ya kitoko
items.description: Ba-playlists ya genre, ba-ambiances mpe ba-collections ya régions — mises à jour pɔsɔ na pɔsɔ.

items.title: Ba-événements en direct
items.description: Kumisa concerts, festivals mpe ba-sessions live pene na yo. Somba ba-billets mpe landa ba-artistes.

items.title: Bokaboli ya bosembo
items.description: Ba-calculs ya royalties transparentes na ventilation ya tango ya solo — par écoute, téléchargement, licence mpe sync.

items.title: Mafuta ya mbala moko
items.description: Sɛngá mafuta tango nyonso via Orange Money, M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Flutterwave to virement. Kozela mikolo 90 te.

items.title: Contrôle créatif mobimba
items.description: Ba-artistes babatelaka masters na bango. Téléchargez, distribuer mpe bongisa catalogue na yo na bonsomi mobimba.

regions.title: Mongongo nyonso,
regions.description: Banda Lagos tii Nairobi, Johannesburg tii Dakar — Zonga ekómisaka makasi miziki nyonso ya Afrika.

mission.title: Miziki oyo
mission.description: Zonga ebotamaki na bondimi ya pétéé: miziki ya Afrika eméritaka plateforme oyo etiaka bayoki na ba-créateurs liboso. Bayoki bazwi accès ofele na catalogue ya kitoko koleka ya miziki ya Afrika. Ba-créateurs bazwi 85% ya écoute nyonso. Ba-labels bakoli sans effort. Moto nyonso azwi.

regions.title: Mongongo nyonso,
regions.description: Banda Lagos tii Nairobi, Johannesburg tii Dakar — Zonga ezali kopesa nguya na miziki nyonso ya Afrika.

partnership.title: Etongami na
partnership.description: Zonga esalaka na ba-organisations oyo bazali na mokano moko mpo na miziki ya bosembo — banda distribution tii na lisalisi ya communauté.

cta.title: Obongani mpo na kosangana na
cta.description: Soki oyoki, osali, okambi to obongisi — Zonga ezali esika miziki ya Afrika ezali kolonga. Yoká ofele. Panzá miziki na yo. Sangana na mouvement.

footer.ctaTitle: Obongani mpo na kopanza miziki na yo?
footer.ctaDescription: Sangana na bankóto ya ba-créateurs ya Afrika na Zonga.
footer.tagline: Plateforme ya miziki ya bosembo — redevances ya polele, mafuta ya mbala moko, mpe bozwi mobimba ya mosala mpo na ba-artistes mpe ba-créateurs ya Afrika.
